# ToolCairn

> Graph-powered tool intelligence for AI agents and developers.

ToolCairn is an open-source platform that helps AI agents and developers find, compare, and
evaluate open source tools. It indexes 12,000+ tools, stores relationships in a knowledge graph
(Memgraph), and exposes a 4-stage search pipeline via an MCP server.

## What ToolCairn Does

- **Tool search**: Natural-language queries return ranked tools with confidence scores
- **Tool comparison**: Side-by-side health metrics, commit activity, ecosystem signals
- **Stack recommendation**: Describe a project, get a curated tool stack
- **Compatibility checking**: Know if two tools are known to work together
- **Issue lookup**: Check known GitHub issues before wasting debugging hours

## How to Use (MCP Integration)

Add to your MCP config (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "toolcairn": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@neurynae/toolcairn-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Install: `npx @neurynae/toolcairn-mcp`

## Available MCP Tools

- `search_tools` — Natural-language tool discovery with guided clarification
- `search_tools_respond` — Submit clarification answers to refine results
- `get_stack` — Full stack recommendation for a project description
- `compare_tools` — Head-to-head comparison of two tools
- `check_compatibility` — Check if two tools are known to work together
- `check_issue` — Look up known bugs for a tool
- `report_outcome` — Feed results back to improve recommendations
- `refine_requirement` — Decompose vague needs into searchable requirements
- `verify_suggestion` — Validate agent-suggested tools against the graph
- `suggest_graph_update` — Contribute new tool relationships to the graph
- `toolcairn_init` — Set up ToolCairn for the current project
- `init_project_config` — Initialize project configuration
- `read_project_config` — Read and validate project config
- `update_project_config` — Add/remove tools from project config
- `toolcairn_auth` — Authenticate with ToolCairn (login / status / logout)

## Architecture

- **Knowledge graph**: Memgraph (Neo4j-compatible) storing tool nodes and relationships
- **Vector search**: Qdrant with Nomic Embed Code 768d embeddings
- **Search pipeline**: 4 stages — BM25+Vector → Graph re-ranking → Clarification → Final selection
- **API**: Hono (Node.js) on AWS EC2, fronted by a Cloudflare Worker
- **npm package**: `@neurynae/toolcairn-mcp` (v0.2.0+)
